notes:
Account background:
- Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Customer-facing product search + support chat. Heavy embedding and rerank usage for knowledge surfaces.
- Started with Hosted API evaluation (Q4 demos) — good core dev velocity. Now moving toward Dedicated to lock latency and cost.
Timeline / recent activity:
- 2024-11-04: inbound via demo signup; initial discovery with AE (Ava).
- 2024-11-12: product demo (hosted) for eng + infra; performed live embedding test (small data).
- 2024-11-20: security sync — requested SOC2 scope, SSO/SAML integration pattern, KMS encryption walkthrough.
- 2024-11-26: pricing review call (Ava + Daniel) — mid-market ARR expectations, asked about reserved capacity vs burst.
- 2024-12-02: technical deep-dive with SE (ff-10294-20241202). Agreed on Dedicated POC scope.
POC scope (4 weeks) — high level:
- Objective: validate Dedicated performance and routing policy for production chat + rerank flows; confirm cost delta vs Hosted; validate SSO + KMS + audit logging.
- Canary plan: route 5-10% production traffic to Dedicated pool for week 1-2, monitor p95 latency, tokens/sec, and error rate. If stability OK, ramp to 30% week 3, full roll week 4.
- Fallback routing: primary -> Dedicated; fallback path = Hosted API (same model family) or Dedicated smaller quantized variant if resource constrained. Automated policy: if Dedicated p95 > 2x baseline OR error_rate > 0.5% for 10m, fail traffic back to Hosted.
- Model variants: baseline is customer-specified open model (13B quantized). POC to test three variants: full fp16-13B, q4_0-13B, q4_1-13B (tradeoff quality vs cost). SE will run side-by-side evals on representative prompt set.
- Region failover: primary Dedicated pool in us-west-2; secondary fallback in us-east-1 (Dedicated or Hosted depending on capacity). Test scenario: simulate us-west outage -> measure failover time (target < 60s to reroute) and correctness.
- Rollback: immediate traffic cut to Hosted by routing policy; rollback playbook documented in Drive (drive://redwood/poc-larkspur-dedicated-pricing-v2). SE to execute rollback during canary if threshold triggers.
Acceptance criteria:
- Latency: p95 generation latency < 120ms for short chat messages (avg length < 120 tokens) during 95% of test windows.
- Quality: automated evals on 500 prompt set show <= 3% regressions vs Hosted baseline or pass human spot checks.
- Reliability: error rate < 0.5% and no more than one incident requiring manual rollback during POC.
- Cost: projected unit token cost reduction >= 20% vs Hosted at expected QPS.
Security / compliance notes:
- Must support customer's KMS flow for key rotation; legal wants clarifications on where keys are held during Dedicated lifecycle.
- Data residency: customer keeps embeddings in their VPC; audit logs to be exported to their SIEM (Splunk) daily.
- SSO: want SCIM provisioning + SAML; demoed SSO flow, client to share IdP metadata (thread-2024-12-03-4532).
Pricing & commercial:
- Customer prefers committed monthly reserved pool but wants a 2-week trial at reduced commit while POC runs. Discussed monthly tiers and overage pricing. SE to provide Dedicated sizing calc by 2024-12-09.
Quotes / direct feedback:
- VP Product (quoted): "If we can get p95 under 100ms with predictable cost, this replaces a lot of infra work for us."
- Eng lead: "Need deterministic rollbacks and a clear canary runbook — we can't risk noisy neighbor spikes."
Next steps (short):
- 2024-12-06: SE to deliver sizing + recommended quantization profile (Daniel).
- 2024-12-09: Legal to receive DPA + KMS annex; billing to prepare provisional PO.
- 2024-12-10: POC kickoff call + initial provisioning.
Open blockers (summary): legal DPA, SOC2 attestation copy for Dedicated, billing PO approval.
